dishes.name: Fouée
dishes.desc: Hollow flatbread baked in a wood oven and filled with rillettes, white beans and butter. Saumur's cave restaurants serve them hot by the basket.

dishes.name: Rillauds d'Anjou
dishes.desc: Chunks of pork belly slowly cooked and caramelised in lard, eaten warm with mustard. A staple of Anjou butchers and market days.

dishes.name: Crémet d'Anjou
dishes.desc: Light dessert of whipped cream, whipped egg white and fromage frais, served cold with cream or red fruit. A speciality of Angers and the Maine-et-Loire.

dishes.name: Quernons d'ardoise
dishes.desc: Almond-and-hazelnut nougatine coated in blue-grey chocolate to look like Angers' roof slate. A sweet from Angers confectioners.

dishes.name: Galipettes
dishes.desc: Large button mushrooms grown in the tuffeau caves around Saumur, stuffed with rillettes or garlic and herbs, and baked. Eaten in cave restaurants.
